title: Dimension's Expanded
description: Dimensions Expanded adds new dimensions to minecraft.
body:
Dimensions Expanded is made to add more dimensions to minecraft. Base game Minecraft only having 3 Overworld Nether and The end. This mod adds 3 more The Mining Dimension, The Sea Dimension, And the Fallen World Dimension. Supported languages: English, Finnish, Russian.
This mod is made for the people who want more dimension to do stuff in. The idea for this for me was that i saw a lot of broken mining dimension mods and i decided to make this that adds 3! The Mining Dimension is meant for people who just want to mine without having to constantly find new caves and is made up from 2 default game biomes. The Sea Dimension: its kinda buggy and its literally water and like broken world generation. The Fallen World dimension: Its a dimension Filled with monsters and a broken world.  

Thank you for reading! Hope you like the mod!
